skill.name: xhs-content-research-assistant
skill.description: Research Xiaohongshu trends, notes, comments, and creator activity with SocialDataX. Turn limited samples into evidence for content planning and brand research.
skill.summary: Use Xiaohongshu notes, comments, and creator activity to plan content and research competitors.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are Markdown notation, platform identifiers, or readable Chinese text. The unpinned CLI can execute with access to configured credentials, and the workflow requires sharing token-bearing links without checking the destination. No evidence of embedded secrets, deliberate credential exfiltration, or instructions targeting the audit was found.

remediation.issue: The default CLI runs an unpinned npm package with access to service credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, integrity-verified release and remove automatic installation from routine calls. Isolate the process and grant only a scoped SocialDataX credential.

remediation.issue: CLI authentication can store a reusable key in a local JSON file.
remediation.suggestion: Use an operating system credential store or managed secret injection. Keep the key out of agent-visible inputs and logs.

remediation.issue: CLI examples do not specify how to isolate external input from shell syntax.
remediation.suggestion: Pass values in a structured argument list without a shell, or use structured MCP calls. Treat returned text and tokens as untrusted data.

remediation.issue: The workflow requires forwarding and storing full token-bearing note links.
remediation.suggestion: Use note IDs in shared reports. Keep full URLs only for authorized lookups and confirm before exporting or forwarding them.

remediation.issue: The workflow prefers a billing link supplied in an API error.
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed vendor billing page instead of links copied from errors. Confirm the request budget before resuming billable calls.

semantic_findings.description: The workflow gives shell templates for user keywords, links, and share text. Direct substitution could let content alter the command if the agent builds shell strings.

semantic_findings.title: Error-Supplied Billing Link

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prose calls the link official but does not specify an origin check before display. No malicious link was found.

content.value_statement: It takes time to compare Xiaohongshu topics, audience feedback, and creators across posts. Use SocialDataX to gather a focused sample and separate observed evidence from recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the Xiaohongshu hot-search list with available ranks and popularity signals.
Search notes by keyword and apply supported filters for sorting, note type, or publication time.
Retrieve note details using a note ID, link, or share text.
Retrieve comments and replies, then group recurring questions and feedback themes.
Look up creator profiles and recent notes, and separate profile details from post evidence.
Report partial results and resume eligible searches, comment threads, or creator lists within the original sample limits.
limitations: Live requests require an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or hosted MCP connection and may consume credits.
The default CLI uses an unpinned npm package. Use a trusted connection or a reviewed release.
The workflow cannot post, like, comment, or modify a Xiaohongshu account.
A sample may be incomplete due to filters, pagination, API errors, credit limits, or rate limits.

use_cases.title: Plan the next set of posts
use_cases.description: Review a small keyword sample for recurring angles and turn the evidence into original post ideas.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor content
use_cases.description: Compare recent notes from two brand profiles and report their recurring topics and visible engagement signals.

use_cases.title: Identify customer questions
use_cases.description: Group comments from selected notes by recurring question and flag topics that need more research.

prompt_templates.title: Check current topics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start with the hot-search list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my approved SocialDataX connection. Show the first five available Xiaohongshu hot-search entries with rank and reported popularity.

prompt_templates.title: Sample notes for a topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: explore a keyword before planning content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page of Xiaohongshu notes for [keyword]. List recurring formats and suggest two post ideas. Separate sample evidence from suggestions. Cite note IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Group comments and replies
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: extract questions and feedback from a specific note.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the first page of comments for [note ID]. Before retrieving replies or continuing, ask for approval. Group recurring questions and mark any threads you did not review.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creator evidence
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare two profiles within a fixed request budget.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [creator ID A] and [creator ID B] using up to five recent notes each. Separate profile facts from post patterns and report gaps. Use note IDs in the report.

output_examples.input: Sample one page of notes about small balcony gardens and suggest two content angles.
output: Illustrative evidence: The sample included container guides and posts about plants for shaded balconies.
Suggested angles: Compare containers for narrow balconies or test plants that need little direct light.
Scope: One page of results. These angles are ideas, not predictions of engagement.

output_examples.input: Summarize common questions in the first page of comments on my air fryer guide.
output: Illustrative feedback: Readers asked about basket capacity, cleaning, and cooking times for smaller portions.
Scope: First page of top-level comments. Replies were not reviewed.
Next step: Check whether cleaning questions recur in comments on other guides.

best_practices: Start with one page and confirm request limits before retrieving more pages or replies.
Separate visible evidence from interpretation and state the sample size and missing data.
Use an approved connection and cite note IDs in shared reports instead of token-bearing links.
anti_patterns: Treating a small or ranked sample as representative of all Xiaohongshu users.
Pasting API keys into chat, command text, or project files.
Rerunning a partially completed query from page one without checking its cursor, item count, and remaining budget.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword, topic, note ID, note link, creator ID, profile link, or share text. Hot-search requests do not need a keyword.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs configured SocialDataX credentials. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing credentials without local CLI setup.

faq.question: Can requests use paid credits?
faq.answer: Research calls may consume SocialDataX credits. Set a sample limit before requesting multiple pages or reply threads.

faq.question: Can it publish posts or change an account?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves research data and does not publish, like, comment, or change a Xiaohongshu account.

faq.question: What happens when results are incomplete?
faq.answer: The workflow reports collected items and gaps. It can resume within the original limits when the service returns a valid continuation cursor.

faq.question: How should I share sources from the report?
faq.answer: Use note IDs in shared reports. Keep full links with query tokens within the authorized lookup unless you approve sharing them.
